title: postexportKinetics: Kinetic Model Comparison for Post-Export RNA Conversion
description:
R package for compartment-resolved four-state kinetic modelling of nuclear and cytoplasmic, unprocessed and processed RNA. It implements a constrained nested-model comparison between a null model without a post-export conversion rate (sigma_c = 0) and a full model with a non-negative post-export conversion rate (sigma_c >= 0), using trapezoidal interval balances, propagated and regularised covariance, whitened non-negative least squares and a replicate-level generative bootstrap with an add-one p-value. It also provides simulation, design diagnostics against the manuscript benchmark, multiple-testing adjustment, exploratory ranking, tidy tables and plots.

sigma_c is a phenomenological post-export conversion rate: statistical support indicates kinetic patterns consistent with an additional post-export conversion component and does not identify a specific molecular mechanism.

The numerical core reproduces the frozen manuscript implementation (tag manuscript-revision-v1.0, commit 65c3b7368fb7686bfde3dab857f98c393bb534c5), archived separately at doi:10.5281/zenodo.22944109. The associated manuscript has been submitted and is not yet published. This package is not a Bioconductor release.
